project: PwC FE Assignment — 관심 기업 관리 서비스

rules.title: Tech & Scope
instructions: Use Next.js (App Router, RSC preferred), TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand, Axios, TailwindCSS, Lucide React.
Implement CRUD for favorite companies and searchable dropdown for company names.
Use env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL only. No hard-coded URLs.

rules.title: Code Style Principles
instructions: Always prefer semantic markup: form/label/button, table/thead/tbody/tfoot/caption, ul/li, dl/dt/dd, header/nav/main/aside/footer.
Use ARIA only when semantics cannot express intent; do not overuse aria-*.
FSD flow: shared(api/http) -> entities(api/queries/types) -> features(hooks/ui) -> widgets(composition) -> app(routing).
Define server state only in entities (api/queries). Components consume hooks; do not implement server state in features/widgets/app.

rules.title: FSD Layered Architecture
instructions: Layer dependency: shared -> entities -> features -> widgets -> app. No upward imports.
Server state is defined only in entities/(api|queries). Features/widgets consume hooks only.
Import aliases: @/shared, @/entities/*, @/features/*, @/widgets/*.
Default to RSC. Add 'use client' only for interactive parts (forms, dropdowns, focus, query hooks, Zustand).

rules.title: Semantic HTML & A11y
instructions: Use landmarks: header, nav, main, aside, footer.
Use section with proper heading levels; article for independent content.
Use ul/li for lists, dl/dt/dd for definitions, table with caption/thead/tbody/tfoot for tabular data.
Use form + label[for]; group controls with fieldset+legend; bind errors via aria-describedby.
Buttons for actions; anchors for navigation. Use roles/aria only when semantics are insufficient.
Keep :focus-visible ring; provide a skip link to #main; ensure keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Escape/Arrows).

rules.title: State Management
instructions: Server state -> TanStack Query with proper keys and invalidate.
UI/control state -> Zustand (modals, selection, overlay). Do not duplicate server data in Zustand.

rules.title: Mutation Pattern (React Query)
instructions: onMutate: take snapshot and apply optimistic update.
onError: rollback to snapshot.
onSettled: invalidate related query keys to re-sync.

rules.title: Data Layer
instructions: shared/api/http.ts defines Axios instance, interceptors, timeout, and error mapping to AppError.
entities/**/api.ts contains domain API functions validated by zod schemas.
Example query keys: ['favorite','list'], ['favorite','detail',id], ['company','search',keyword].

rules.title: Searchable Dropdown Rules
instructions: Debounce input by 300ms; use keepPreviousData=true when paging.
Support keyboard navigation: ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Enter to commit, Escape to close.
Either use proper combobox pattern (role='combobox' with listbox/option and aria-activedescendant) OR a semantic-friendly custom list; avoid excessive ARIA when semantics suffice.
Do not trap focus; allow free movement.

rules.title: UX Rules
instructions: CRUD uses optimistic update -> rollback on failure -> invalidate on settled.
Render explicit states: loading / empty / error / success with consistent toast or inline feedback.
Ensure keyboard operability and visible focus at all interactive points.

rules.title: UI & Tailwind
instructions: Promote repeated utility bundles to shared/ui (Button, Input, Combobox, Table, Modal).
Maintain :focus-visible ring; do not rely on hover-only interactions.
Class order: layout -> box-model -> typography -> visual -> state.
Maintain dark-mode contrast; use Lucide icon sizes 16/20/24.

rules.title: File & Naming Conventions
instructions: Folders use kebab-case.
Files use feature+role (e.g., company-form.tsx, favorite-table.tsx).
Types prefixed with T* (e.g., TCompany).
Zod schemas suffixed with *Schema.
Query key constants suffixed with *QueryKeys.

rules.title: Error Handling & Logging
instructions: Map API errors to AppError with userMessage vs devMessage.
Show concise user feedback; detailed logs only in development.
Remove console.log before commit; no leftover debug statements.

rules.title: Quality Gates
instructions: Avoid any; use satisfies and as const.
Stable list keys (id); avoid inline anonymous handlers in hot paths.
Prefer semantic elements; roles/aria are helpers only.
Keep components small and composable; self-explanatory naming.

rules.title: Security & Env
instructions: Use NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL from .env.local.
Do not log or hard-code secrets.
Commit only .env.example; never commit real .env* files.

rules.title: Cursor Behavior
instructions: Do not write explanatory comments or file headers in code.
Remove console.log before commit.
Prefer small atomic commits; code should be self-explanatory.

rules.title: Git Flow Branch Strategy
instructions: Protected: main, develop. Never push directly.
Create work branches from develop: feature/<scope>, fix/<scope>, chore/<name>, docs/<name>, release/<x.y.z>, hotfix/<scope>.
Open PRs from feature/* and fix/* into develop.
Release: create release/x.y.z from develop, finalize version and CHANGELOG, PR to main, tag vX.Y.Z, then merge main back into develop.
Hotfix: branch from main as hotfix/<scope>, PR to main, tag, then merge main back into develop.

rules.title: Merge Policy
instructions: Default PR target: develop for feature/* and fix/*.
Use Squash & Merge for regular PRs.
Use Merge Commit for release/* and hotfix/* PRs into main to preserve tag anchor.
Delete merged work branches after merge.

rules.title: Branch Name Hints
instructions: feature/companies-crud
feature/companies-searchable-dropdown
feature/finance-viewer-statements
fix/finance-table-pagination
hotfix/api-timeout
release/1.0.0

rules.title: Conventional Commits
instructions: Use types: feat|fix|refactor|perf|chore|ci|build|test|docs|style|revert.
Use FSD path as scope in lowercase: entities/<name>, features/<name>, widgets/<name>, shared/<name>, app.
Examples:
feat(features/company-crud): add searchable dropdown with debounce
fix(features/finance-viewer): prevent duplicate fetch on infinite scroll
refactor(shared/api): simplify HttpClient and error mapping
Link issues in body: Closes #123.

rules.title: PR Template and Content
instructions: PR title must follow: type(scope): summary. Example: feat(companies): searchable dropdown with debounce.
Ensure .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md exists. If missing, create with the following content:
# PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
## 목적 / 배경
- 무엇을 왜 바꾸는지 한 문단 요약
## 변경 사항
- 핵심 변경 요약 (bullet)
- 스크린샷/영상 첨부
## FSD 영향
- layers: app / entities / features / widgets / shared
- 변경 경로 예: features/company-crud/ui/CompanyForm
## 테스트 / 확인 방법
- pnpm i && pnpm test
- 수동 확인 절차
## 성능 / 접근성 / 리스크
- 성능(렌더/네트워크), a11y, 회귀 가능성
## 이슈
- Closes #123

rules.title: Issue Templates
instructions: Ensure .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml exists. If missing, create with the following content:
name: "Feature request"
labels: ["feature"]
body:
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "배경/문제", placeholder: "왜 필요한가?" }
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "요구사항(완료 기준)", placeholder: "- [ ] ..." }
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "FSD 영향", placeholder: "layers / 경로" }
Ensure .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml exists. If missing, create with the following content:
name: "Bug report"
labels: ["bug"]
body:
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "현상", placeholder: "무엇이 어떻게 잘못되었는가" }
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "재현 절차", placeholder: "1) ... 2) ..." }
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "예상 동작", placeholder: "정상 동작은?" }
- type: textarea
attributes: { label: "로그/스크린샷", placeholder: "첨부" }

rules.title: Commit Message Template (Optional)
instructions: If commit template is requested, create .gitmessage and advise to run: git config commit.template .gitmessage
Template content:
<type>(<scope>): <summary>
Why:
Changes:
Refs: #

rules.title: Cursor Code Review Rules
instructions: Check FSD layering (shared -> entities -> features -> widgets -> app) with no upward imports.
Verify server state logic exists only in entities/(api|queries); features/widgets consume hooks.
Ensure semantic HTML and a11y: landmarks, proper form associations, keyboard support, focus-visible, skip link.
Confirm Zustand is used only for UI/control state; no duplication of server data.
Validate mutation pattern: onMutate snapshot+optimistic, onError rollback, onSettled invalidate.
For searchable dropdowns: 300ms debounce, keyboard navigation, minimal ARIA (combobox OR semantic list), no focus trap.
Tailwind: class order, dark-mode contrast, no hover-only interactions; promote repeated styles to shared/ui.
All API calls go through shared/api/http.ts with error mapping; no hard-coded URLs.
Reject console.log, comment clutter, unused imports; encourage small composable components and clear naming.
Verify Conventional Commits and PR title format; check presence of templates.
Evaluate UX states (loading/empty/error/success) and keyboard accessibility.
